race.comment: TRANSGRESS (4) improved sharply last start at Ipswich when closing off well into fourth. Has been kept fresh for this and can take this out if he holds his form. CAISHEN (3) returns and is a noted fresh performer. Is a relatively lightly-raced five-year-old that has shown glimpses of ability. Gets in well with the 2kg claim and should take a strong account of himself fresh. ICEWATER (15) has been showing good tactical speed of late, so expect Wheatley to take full advantage of the low draw and be handy throughout. Doesn't need to improve much to get the verdict. GOLD PUMA (8) caught the eye late last time when finishing off well into midfield. Fitter third-up and gets Looker taking over in the saddle.
